_about: MYK9-2005. One ranking, two implementations: the paper-scoring page's calculatePlacements (apps/myk9show/src/pages/scoring/__tests__/qualifiedRankingParity.test.ts) and the server's recalculate_class_placements (supabase/tests/myk9_2005_qualified_time_test.sql section D, which mirrors these cases by position). Change a case here and in both. No two Qualified dogs tie, so a coin flip never decides a placement. status is the result_status value; time is seconds, null for none.

cases.name: a Qualified with a time of zero or none is never ranked
fewest faults first, then the fastest time
